name: ccatlas
description: Inventory, freshness, usage and portability for your Claude Code extensions. Finds stale pins that `/plugin update` reports as up to date.

sync_repo.title: Sync repository
sync_repo.description: Git remote for `ccatlas sync`. Leave empty to disable sync.

sync_token.title: Sync token
sync_token.description: Token for a private sync remote. Stored in the OS keychain, never exported.

drift_notice.title: Session-start drift notice
drift_notice.description: Print a one-line notice at session start. Reads the cache only; never networks.

autocommit_on_exit.title: Auto-commit on session end
autocommit_on_exit.description: Commit stack changes to the sync repository when a session ends.
